arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 170 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import t_perf2
from common import validate
import planning
def build_realistic(seed,nreq,noffer,pairs,cost_range):
    import random
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    job=t_perf2.build(seed,nreq=nreq,noffer=noffer,pairs=pairs,distinct_cost=False)
    for o in job['offers']:
        o['cost']=rng.randint(0,cost_range); o['capacity']=rng.randint(1,4)
    return job
for nreq,noffer,pairs,cr in ((500,1000,30000,50),(1000,2000,65000,100),(2000,4000,130000,200)):
    job=build_realistic(11,nreq,noffer,pairs,cr)
    ctx=validate(job)
    t=time.time(); res=planning.solve(ctx,{r['id']:True for r in job['requests']})
    print(f'realistic n={nreq} pairs={pairs}: {time.time()-t:.1f}s resolved={res["resolved"]}',flush=True)
for nreq,noffer,pairs in ((256,512,16384),(512,1024,32768)):
    job=t_perf2.build(7,nreq=nreq,noffer=noffer,pairs=pairs)
    ctx=validate(job)
    t=time.time(); res=planning.solve(ctx,{r['id']:True for r in job['requests']})
    print(f'adversarial n={nreq} pairs={pairs}: {time.time()-t:.1f}s resolved={res["resolved"]}',flush=True)
PYEOF
